description: A complete in-order C_PDU held behind a missing D_PDU, and already acknowledged, is delivered when the link ends.
note: As dts-arq/deliver-in-order up to 93550: the link is made with 0.0.1.3 as the Called node, B (FSN 1, DELIVER IN ORDER) is complete but held because FSN 0 (A) is missing (C-0178, C-1123), C (FSN 2, no flag) is delivered at once (C-0179), and our ACK-ONLY at 88000 acknowledges FSNs 1 and 2 (RX LWE 0, bitmap 0x03), so the peer counts B as delivered. Instead of sending A again, the peer breaks the link: at 101000 a type 8 D_PDU with PHYSICAL LINK BREAK, reason 4 (octet 44), its C_PDU ID 1. This node is the Responder: the link is broken at once, link_state unlinked, PHYSICAL LINK BREAK CONFIRM queued, D_CONNECTION_TERMINATED to the DTS and C_PHYSICAL_LINK_BROKEN to the SIS, which stops its soft link timers (B-0284, B-0285, A-0199); cas.first_data had already stopped when B was held (B-0215, B-0460). The gap before B can no longer be filled, and B was acknowledged, so before the connection's state is reset the DTS delivers it (C-1254): the client gets "bbbb". Nothing of ours was queued for the link, so nothing is rejected (C-0652, C-0866). The burst ends at 102000: csma.vdcd_end 4000, LBT rule 1, contention 45000 ms, and at 151000 the confirm goes out with our C_PDU ID 1. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000 ms (K-0080). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly, C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived from the answer wait (A-0321).
